IS: 9773 -1981 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
VOLUME GREASE PUMPS 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



1. Scope — Covers the requirements for manually operated bucket type volume grease pumps 
intended for use with self collapsing greases up to Group 1 of 310-340 penetration number and 
heavy oils of viscosity 150CST at 40°C. 

2. Material — The materials used for volume pumps shall be such as to withstand normal wear and 
handling when used with grease or oil up to a temperature of 60°C. 

3. Nominal Capacity — 20 litres. 

4. Dimensions — Shall be as shown in Fig. 1. 




575 




All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 DIMENSIONS FOR VOLUME GREASE PUMP 

5. Designation — Volume grease pump having a nominal capacity of 20 litres shall be designated as: 
Volume Grease Pump 20 IS : 9773. 



Adopted 13 March 1981 



July 1981, ISI

IS: 9773 -1981 

6. Design Features 

6.1 Volume pumps shall be robust in construction and easy for operation. 

6.2 Volume pumps shall be provided with pressure relief to facilitate easy disengaging of connectors 
from grease nipples. 

6.3 All packings shall be made from oil resisting materials. 

7. Workmanship and Finish 

7.1 The volume pumps shall be finished smooth and shall be free from burrs, cracks and other 
manufacturing defects. 

7.2 Exposed surfaces of volume grease pumps that come in contact with grease shall be plated and 
the rest painted with oil resistant paint. Fasteners shall be zinc/cadmium plated. 

8. Performance Test — The volume grease pump shall have discharge rates per stroke as given below 
corresponding to discharge pressures of the pump : 



Discharge 
Pressure in MPa*

9. Marking — The volume pumps shall be marked with nominal capacity and manufacturer's name or 
trade-mark, 

9.1 fSf Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

10. Packing — The volume pumps shall be packed in accordance with best prevalent trade practices 
or as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers the requirements of manually operated bucket type volume grease pumps 
and is based on the manufacturing practices followed in the country. 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
